title: 第4章 紫气境九重！

content_zh:
这种速度至少比外界快了百倍不止。
当大量的血雾进|入灵魂之中的时候，姜辰第|一|次感觉身|体之中，不再刺痛。
不仅如此，姜辰的武脉，也被一点点的分裂又一点点的融合。
很快，所有的伤痕消失了，姜辰已经开启的武脉穴位，从小溪，化作了无边的海洋。
这是一种令人无比震撼的蜕变。
便是这一刻的修炼，他的武脉不仅不再伤痕累累，反而比之之前最巅|峰的时候还要逆天太多太多。
之前，哪怕是曾经的巅|峰状态，武脉，也不过如河流一般大小。
可如今，武脉如海般雄壮，真气如汪洋，奔腾不息。
姜辰开始凝神屏息，在这个空间突破武脉，却第|一|次感受到了桎梏。
当下，姜辰明白，此地，或许并不适合突破。
心念一动，姜辰出现在了外界。
他的身|上，此时已经流淌出了大量黑色的淤泥，奇臭无比。
臭气熏天，只怕是隔着万米的距离，都令人无法忍受。
远方飞舞着的野鹤，早已经消失不见。
唯一离得近一些的寒潭上，还漂浮着一只灰白|色的野鹤，看样子是离得近，被活活熏死的。
姜辰瞪大眼睛看着这一幕，随即有些讪讪的|摸|了一把自己的额头。
一把下去，手中一片粘稠的黑色淤泥。
姜辰无奈，当下跳入寒潭，仔细清洗身|体，衣物。
随后，他重新穿好衣服，并继续在寒潭旁盘坐下来，凝练真气，开始修炼《天河剑诀》，并继续冲|击武脉。
这一次，姜辰没有迟疑，立刻引导能量运转，并开始叠加、压缩真气，化真气为针。

同时，真气之针，被螺旋旋转着的压缩真气爆发推动，陡然射|出。
“咻——”
真气在体|内，如一道杀|戮之剑，陡然射杀而出。
“噗嗤——”
那厚实的武脉穴位淤塞，直接被瞬间打穿。
这还不止，那爆发出的真气之针，携带着暴戾的冲|击力，沿着武脉继续向前，“噗噗”两声，接连又打穿了天枢武脉的两大穴位。
“噗——”
撕裂的刺痛，让姜辰浑身剧烈的抽|搐了三下，同时，他一口血雾无法控制的喷了出来。
他的脸色陡然变得苍白了起来。
但，下一刻，体|内的真气穿透了被贯穿的两大穴位，裂开的穴位逐渐的被扩大，被后续的真气逐渐撕裂炼化，姜辰的痛苦也逐渐减轻。
境界，在这一刻，跨入了后天武者境第七重。
而且，还打通了第七重境界的四个穴位之中的前三个。
一鼓作气，姜辰没有迟疑，以同样的方法，再次的压缩真气，爆发，将真气化作真气之针，刺穿自己的武脉。
“轰！”
很快，第二十八道，第二十九道穴位相继被贯穿。
第二十九个穴位被贯穿，便说明，姜辰的境界，已经达到了后天武者境第八重。
到了后天境武者第八重之后，姜辰便有资格修炼《天河剑诀》第三层的心法。
如此一来，心法强大了，体|内的真气的底蕴更强，爆发力更可怕。
如此循环，仅仅两个时辰，姜辰，便已经打穿了天枢武脉的第三十六个穴位，达到了后天九重境界巅|峰之境。
这个时候，只需要凝练真气，感悟天地间的意志，便可以没有悬念的进|入先天紫气境。

但，姜辰没有这么做。
他来来回回的将整条天枢武脉的穴位全部扩大到了近乎爆裂的极致之后，便开始以同样的方法去开启‘慧光’和‘灵动’两大隐匿武脉。
只是，这一次，同样的方式，似乎有些失效。
不仅慧光武脉没有被撼动，灵动武脉，也同样的没有被针形状的真气击穿。
这，让姜辰不由沉默了起来。
沉默之中，姜河暂时放弃了武脉，开始打通正十二经和奇经八脉，同时这一系列过程，倒是没有多大阻碍，很快完成。
之后，姜辰开始运用最后的一种突破之法——真气化剑，以剑道破武脉！
凝神屏息，深吸一口气后，姜辰开始以这样的方法，开辟‘慧光’武脉。
“嗤嗤——”
经络之内，真气化剑，爆发的瞬间，真气之剑杀出一道紫光，同时发出了尖锐的爆鸣声。
同一时刻，“噗噗噗”的声音连成一片。
真气之剑，一次爆发，打穿了十二道坚固的穴位！

content_en:
This speed is at least a hundred times faster than the outside world.
When a large amount of blood mist entered his soul, Jiang Chen felt for the first time that there was no more pain in his body.
Not only that, Jiang Chen's martial arts were also split bit by bit and merged bit by bit.
Soon, all the scars disappeared, and Jiang Chen's opened martial arts acupoints turned from the creek into a boundless ocean.
This is an extremely shocking transformation.
Just at this moment of cultivation, not only was his martial arts no longer scarred, but it was even worse than when it was at its peak.
Before, even at its peak state, the martial arteries were only as big as a river.
But now, the martial arts are as majestic as the sea, and the true energy is like the ocean, rushing endlessly.
Jiang Chen began to concentrate and hold his breath, breaking through the martial arts in this space, but felt the shackles for the first time.
At that moment, Jiang Chen understood that this place might not be suitable for a breakthrough.
With a thought in his mind, Jiang Chen appeared in the outside world.
A large amount of black sludge was flowing out of his body at this time, and it was extremely smelly.
The stench is so thick that it is unbearable even from a distance of 10,000 meters.
The wild cranes flying in the distance have long since disappeared.
There was a gray-white wild crane floating on the only cold pool that was closer. It looked like it had been smoked to death because it was so close.
Jiang Chen stared at this scene with wide eyes, and then touched his forehead with some sarcasm.
When he took it down, there was a sticky black sludge in his hand.
Jiang Chen had no choice but to jump into the cold pool and wash his body and clothes carefully.
Afterwards, he put on his clothes again and continued to sit down by the cold pool, condensing his true energy, began to practice the "Tianhe Sword Art", and continued to attack the martial arts.
This time, Jiang Chen did not hesitate, and immediately directed the energy to circulate, and began to superimpose and compress the true energy, turning the true energy into needles.
At the same time, the needle of true energy was pushed by the spirally rotating burst of compressed true energy, and suddenly shot out.
"Whoops——"
The true energy in the body is like a killing sword, suddenly shooting out.
"Pfft——"
The thick martial art acupuncture points were clogged and were instantly penetrated.
That's not all, the needle of true energy that exploded carried violent impact and continued forward along the martial arteries. With two "pop" sounds, it penetrated the two major acupoints of the Tianshu martial arteries.
"Pfft——"
The tearing pain caused Jiang Chen to twitch violently three times. At the same time, he sprayed out a mouthful of blood mist uncontrollably.
His face suddenly turned pale.
However, the next moment, the true energy in the body penetrated the two major acupoints that were penetrated. The cracked acupuncture points were gradually expanded, and were gradually torn apart and refined by the subsequent true energy. Jiang Chen's pain gradually eased.
At this moment, he entered the seventh level of the acquired warrior realm.
Moreover, it also opened up the first three of the four acupuncture points in the seventh level.
With a burst of energy, Jiang Chen did not hesitate, using the same method, he compressed the true energy again, exploded, turned the true energy into a true energy needle, and pierced his own martial arts.
"Boom!"
Soon, the twenty-eighth and twenty-ninth acupuncture points were penetrated one after another.
The twenty-ninth acupuncture point was penetrated, which showed that Jiang Chen's realm had reached the eighth level of the acquired warrior realm.
After reaching the eighth level of the Houtian realm warrior, Jiang Chen was qualified to practice the third level of the "Tianhe Sword Art".
In this way, the mental technique becomes stronger, the true energy in the body becomes stronger, and the explosive power becomes more terrifying.
After such a cycle, in just two hours, Jiang Chen had penetrated the thirty-sixth acupuncture point of the Tianshu Martial Vein and reached the pinnacle of the acquired ninth level.
At this time, you only need to condense the true energy and understand the will of heaven and earth, and then you can enter the innate purple energy realm without any suspense.
However, Jiang Chen didn't do this.
He went back and forth to expand all the acupuncture points along the Tianshu martial arteries until they were almost bursting.After reaching the extreme, he began to use the same method to open the two hidden martial arts veins of 'Hui Guang' and 'Ling Dong'.
However, this time, the same method seemed to be ineffective.
Not only was the Huiguang Martial Vein unshaken, but the Lingdong Martial Vein was also not penetrated by the needle-shaped Qi.
This made Jiang Chen fall silent.
In silence, Jiang He temporarily gave up on the martial arts and began to open up the twelve main meridians and the eight extraordinary meridians. At the same time, this series of processes was completed quickly without much hindrance.
After that, Jiang Chen began to use the last breakthrough method - transforming the true energy into a sword, using the sword to break the martial arts!
After holding his breath and taking a deep breath, Jiang Chen began to use this method to open up the 'Huiguang' martial arteries.
"Chichi——"
Within the meridians, the true energy turned into a sword. At the moment of the explosion, the true energy sword shot out a purple light and made a sharp explosion at the same time.
At the same moment, there was a continuous sound of "Puff, Puff, Puff".
The sword of true energy broke out in one burst and penetrated twelve strong acupuncture points!
